example1_readback.result: Set the topic to the explicitly named Nara; no assertion yet.
Assert the ordered conjunction WARM(Nara), DRY(Nara).
Prohibit bringing about WARM(Nara). This is not an assertion that Nara is not warm, and not an instruction to cool Nara.

If NOT DRY(Nara), perform STIR(Nara), then check DRY(Nara), repeating the action while false. With the example's initially asserted dryness, this condition would not fire if those assertions hold simultaneously. That does not erase the written conditional instruction.
Assert WARMER-THAN(Nara,Vela). The second entity is explicit and does not become the topic.
Only this explicit header changes the topic.
Bring about NOT WARM(Vela). Not-warm is not automatically cold; no cold root or numerical temperature threshold has been supplied.

Names containing grammar punctuation are inside quotes; an embedded quote needs the specified escape. A finite closed-name list, omitted quote or uncharged replacement of an unknown name is not present in this RAW.
